thread:
Maya Chen: Morning team  new hire Ibrahim arrives Day 1 but his DS-2019 visa stamp is with his passport at customs till 2pm local. Hes in SF. Can we run a Day-1 plan if original passport+stamp not present?
Ibrahim Ali: Hey all  I have digital scans of passport + DS-2019 and an embassy receipt showing passport retention until 14:00. I can be at the lobby by 09:30.
Carmen Ruiz: Hi Ibrahim  for I-9 we need physical ID OR an approved alternative (notarized copy with chain-of-custody). If passport will be delayed, Facilities can accept a notarized copy delivered by courier or you can present an embassy receipt + secondary photo ID for a provisional badge.
Facilities: We can issue a temporary escort badge 09:30-13:30 if Security approves. Need pre-signed visitor form + photo ID scan.
Security: Temporary badge OK with embassy receipt + state ID, but HR must log "I-9 pending original" exception. Escort assigned: Priyanka.
Maya Chen: @Onboard Bot can you create the exception case and notify Payroll about potential tax/residency paperwork delay?
Onboard Bot: Case created: I9-VA-2026-411. Notifying Payroll. Doc requests sent to Ibrahim: notarized copy option + upload link.
Ibrahim Ali: Uploaded embassy_receipt.pdf and a passport_scan. Notarized copy will take time; courier is not preferred.
Carmen Ruiz: Okay  we'll proceed with provisional badge. Payroll: reminder that W-4 and direct deposit are still required for pay. If not completed, first payment may be delayed.
Payroll: Noted. We can accept electronic W-4 + ACH form signed digitally; aim to complete by EOD to avoid delay. Ibrahim, ping payroll if you need a kiosk.
Ibrahim Ali: I can fill forms remotely. Quick Q: will benefits enrollment be available if I start remote Day 1?
Carmen Ruiz: Benefits enrollment window opens Day 1 regardless; coverage effective start-of-next-month. We can schedule a remote benefits walkthrough Day 2.
Maya Chen: Facilities  please confirm lobby pickup code and who will escort. Ill plan a shortened orientation for in-person time.
Facilities: Pickup code REDWOOD-LBY-58. Escort Priyanka will meet Ibrahim at 09:30. Reminder: no access to secure systems until background + original I-9 cleared.
Security: Log updated with I9-VA-2026-411 and escort assignment. Temporary badge expires 13:30.
Maya Chen: Thanks all. Ibrahim  welcome aboard! We'll streamline Day 1: quick team meet, IT checklist, payroll forms. Original passport+stamp follow-up expected same day; if not, we'll arrange courier notarization.
Ibrahim Ali: Appreciate it. I'll be there 09:30 with embassy receipt and state ID, will finish W-4 before lunch. See you then. :thumbsup:
